title: Donna's Art
description: The living portfolio of Donna — original artwork across styles, eras and themes. Browse the gallery, buy originals and prints, or request a commission.
hero_heading: Art made by hand, with heart
hero_text: Welcome to my studio online. Wander through decades of work, find a piece that speaks to you, or ask me to create something just for you.
commissions_text: I love creating custom pieces — portraits of people and pets, favourite places, or something completely new. Tell me what you have in mind and I'll get back to you with ideas, sizes and pricing.
